command:
import pathlib,json,hashlib,zipfile,subprocess,datetime
root=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
folder=(root/'artifacts').resolve()
output=root/'evidence/operations/hygiene/checkpoint-retention-before-recovery.json'
assert not output.exists()
keep=['expertauth-partial-checkpoint-ae8e3f5502d5.zip','expertauth-partial-checkpoint-dc125668bb75.zip']
retire=['expertauth-partial-checkpoint-69c68e8b4994.zip','expertauth-partial-checkpoint-6c3179600b3b.zip','expertauth-partial-checkpoint-a8efedf156c0.zip','expertauth-partial-checkpoint-cfff072df86a.zip','expertauth-partial-checkpoint-d3cc4b0b65a7.zip','expertauth-partial-checkpoint-fefb9daa2d1d.zip']
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
rows=[]
for name in keep+retire:
    path=folder/name
    assert path.resolve().parent==folder and not path.is_symlink() and path.is_file()
    manifest=path.with_suffix('.manifest.json')
    validation=path.with_suffix('.validation.json')
    checksum=path.with_suffix('.zip.sha256')
    m=json.loads(manifest.read_text())
    v=json.loads(validation.read_text())
    digest=sha(path)
    assert m['kind']=='PARTIAL_SOURCE_CHECKPOINT' and m['complete'] is False and m['production_approved'] is False
    assert v['sha256']==digest==checksum.read_text().split()[0] and v['zip']==name
    assert v['bundle_clone_head']==m['commit'] and all(c['actual_exit']==c['expected_exit'] for c in v['checks'])
    subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',m['commit'],'HEAD'],check=True,capture_output=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        assert len(z.infolist())<=10000 and sum(i.file_size for i in z.infolist())<512*1024*1024
        assert z.testzip() is None
        assert z.read('expert-auth/CHECKPOINT_MANIFEST.json')==manifest.read_bytes()
    rows.append({'path':path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'sha256':digest,'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'commit':m['commit'],'action':'keep' if name in keep else 'retire-duplicate-generated-zip','manifest_sha256':sha(manifest),'validation_sha256':sha(validation)})
record={'timestamp':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Only six exact generated source checkpoint ZIPs; preserve newest two, every manifest/checksum/validation sidecar, source commits and all supplied baseline files','policy':'At most three recent generated source ZIPs after packaging the next checkpoint; source/evidence history remains in Git and its newest validated bundle','rows':rows,'errors':[],'logical_archive_bytes_removed':0,'physical_host_bytes_freed':None}
try:
    for row in rows:
        if row['action']!='retire-duplicate-generated-zip':continue
        path=root/row['path']
        assert path.resolve().parent==folder and not path.is_symlink() and sha(path)==row['sha256']
        path.unlink()
        row['retired']=not path.exists()
        record['logical_archive_bytes_removed']+=row['bytes']
    assert all((folder/name).is_file() for name in keep)
    assert all((root/row['path']).with_suffix('.manifest.json').is_file() and (root/row['path']).with_suffix('.validation.json').is_file() and (root/row['path']).with_suffix('.zip.sha256').is_file() for row in rows)
    record['passed']=True
except Exception as error:
    record['errors'].append(type(error).__name__)
    record['passed']=False
finally:
    output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'report':output.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'passed':record['passed'],'logical_archive_bytes_removed':record['logical_archive_bytes_removed'],'retained_validated_zips':len(keep),'errors':record['errors']}))
raise SystemExit(0 if record['passed'] else 1)
